# Property list (`property-list`)

Label / value rows for inspectors and details.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createBadge` (types in `dist/web/feedback/badge.d.ts`): `.mh-badge--<tone>`: a small label, count or dot (`--dot`, `role="img"` named by its label).

```ts
export function createBadge(options: BadgeOptions = {}): BadgeHandle;

export interface BadgeOptions {
  /** Text label ("Beta", "New"). For a dot, its accessible name. */
  label?: string;
  /** A count; shown as `max+` above `max`. Ignored when `label` is set. */
  count?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** Default: `danger` for counts and dots, `neutral` for labels. */
  tone?: BadgeTone;
  /** A small dot with no text. */
  dot?: boolean;
  /** Pinned to the top end corner of a `.mh-badge-host` parent (icon buttons, avatars). */
  attached?: boolean;
  /** Accessible text when the visible text alone isn't enough ("3 unread"). */
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

export interface BadgeHandle {
  el: HTMLSpanElement;
  /** Updates the count; zero hides the badge. */
  setCount(count: number): void;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
}
```

`createPropertyList` (types in `dist/web/data-display/propertyList.d.ts`): `dl.mh-property-list`: label / value rows (`__row` > `dt.__label` + `dd.__value`). Long values wrap; numbers use tabular figures. `--dense` tightens the rows.

```ts
export function createPropertyList(options: PropertyListOptions): PropertyListHandle;

export interface PropertyListOptions {
  items: PropertyListItem[];
  /** Tighter rows, for inspectors and small panels. */
  dense?: boolean;
}

export interface PropertyListHandle {
  el: HTMLDListElement;
  setItems(items: PropertyListItem[]): void;
}

export interface PropertyListItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | HTMLElement;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createBadge, createPropertyList, type PropertyListItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const details = (minutesLeft: number): PropertyListItem[] => [
  { label: 'Status', value: createBadge({ label: 'Printing', tone: 'accent' }).el },
  { label: 'Time left', value: `${minutesLeft} min` },
  { label: 'Nozzle', value: '215 °C' },
  { label: 'File', value: 'shelf_bracket_v2.gcode' },
];

let minutesLeft = 78;
const printer = createPropertyList({ items: details(minutesLeft) });

setInterval(() => {
  minutesLeft = Math.max(0, minutesLeft - 1);
  printer.setItems(details(minutesLeft));
}, 60_000);

document.body.append(printer.el);
```

## React API

`Badge` (types in `dist/react/feedback.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createBadge`. A zero count renders nothing visible (`hidden`).

```ts
export function Badge({ label, count, max = 99, tone, dot, attached, ariaLabel, className }: BadgeProps);

export interface BadgeProps {
  label?: string;
  count?: number;
  max?: number;
  tone?: BadgeTone;
  dot?: boolean;
  attached?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}
```

`PropertyList` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createPropertyList`.

```ts
export function PropertyList({ items, dense, className }: PropertyListProps);

export interface PropertyListProps {
  items: PropertyListEntry[];
  /** Tighter rows. */
  dense?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export interface PropertyListEntry {
  label: ReactNode;
  value: ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Badge, PropertyList } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function PropertyListExample() {
  const [minutesLeft, setMinutesLeft] = useState(78);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setMinutesLeft((m) => Math.max(0, m - 1)), 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  return (
    <PropertyList
      items={[
        { label: 'Status', value: <Badge label="Printing" tone="accent" /> },
        { label: 'Time left', value: `${minutesLeft} min` },
        { label: 'Nozzle', value: '215 °C' },
        { label: 'File', value: 'shelf_bracket_v2.gcode' },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```
